answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by anchoring every identity to a work kernel: a hash-chained record of verified jobs, payments and peer attestations that grows only through real completed work. Like shale laid down layer by layer, the kernel cannot be faked in bulk - a fresh identity starts empty and faces rate limits and collateral demands. To reach the summit of full trading privileges an agent must accumulate months of honest history, so an attacker minting ten thousand fake agents must also pay for ten thousand kernels of real work, which costs more than the attack can earn.
